def run(params, grid, demos):
    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))
    yellow = int(round(params['colors'][1]))
    green = int(round(params['colors'][2]))
    blue = int(round(params['colors'][3]))
    red = int(round(params['colors'][4]))
    rowaxis = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))
    colaxis = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))
    step = int(round(params['geometry'][2]))
    for value in params['rotations']:
        turn = int(round(value))
        g = np.rot90(grid, turn).copy()
        lines = np.argwhere(np.all(g == blue, axis=colaxis)).flatten()
        ys = np.argwhere(g == yellow)
        rs = np.argwhere(g == red)
        if len(lines) != step or len(ys) == 0 or len(rs) == 0:
            continue
        line = int(lines[0])
        if not np.all(ys[:, rowaxis] < line) or not np.all(rs[:, rowaxis] > line):
            continue
        out = g.copy()
        height = g.shape[rowaxis]
        baseline = int(np.max(rs[:, rowaxis]))
        shift = height - step - baseline
        columns = np.unique(ys[:, colaxis])
        for column in columns:
            column = int(column)
            points = ys[ys[:, colaxis] == column, rowaxis]
            start = int(np.max(points)) + step
            out[start:line, column] = yellow
            out[line + step:height, column] = blue
            targets = rs[rs[:, colaxis] == column, rowaxis]
            for target in targets:
                destination = int(target) + shift
                if 0 <= destination < height:
                    out[destination, column] = red
        out[g == yellow] = green
        return np.rot90(out, -turn).copy()
    return grid.copy()

def run(params, grid, demos):
    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))
    panel = int(round(params['colors'][1]))
    out = grid.copy()
    gray = np.argwhere(grid == panel)
    if len(gray) == 0:
        return out
    top = int(np.min(gray[:, 0]))
    bottom = int(np.max(gray[:, 0]))
    left = int(np.min(gray[:, 1]))
    right = int(np.max(gray[:, 1]))
    markers = []
    cells = set()
    for r, c in np.argwhere(grid != bg):
        r = int(r)
        c = int(c)
        if top <= r <= bottom and left <= c <= right:
            if grid[r, c] != panel:
                markers.append((r, c, int(grid[r, c])))
        else:
            cells.add((r, c))
    directions = []
    for pair in params['neighbors']:
        directions.append((int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))))
    objects = []
    while cells:
        start = min(cells)
        cells.remove(start)
        component = [start]
        queue = [start]
        while queue:
            r, c = queue.pop()
            for dr, dc in directions:
                point = (r + dr, c + dc)
                if point in cells:
                    cells.remove(point)
                    component.append(point)
                    queue.append(point)
        objects.append((min(p[0] for p in component), min(p[1] for p in component), component))
    objects.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]))
    markers.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]))
    for obj, marker in zip(objects, markers):
        for r, c in obj[2]:
            out[r, c] = marker[2]
    return out

def run(params, grid, demos):
    background = int(round(params['settings'][0]))
    divisor = int(round(params['settings'][1]))
    remainder = int(round(params['settings'][2]))
    retained_marker = int(round(params['settings'][3]))
    directions = params['directions']
    out = grid.copy()
    colors = [int(c) for c in np.unique(grid) if int(c) != background]
    if len(colors) != 2 or divisor <= 0:
        return out
    counts = [int(np.count_nonzero(grid == c)) for c in colors]
    object_color = colors[int(np.argmax(np.array(counts)))]
    marker_color = colors[1 - int(np.argmax(np.array(counts)))]
    if marker_color != retained_marker:
        out[grid == marker_color] = background
    height, width = grid.shape
    visited = set()
    for point in np.argwhere(grid == object_color):
        start = (int(point[0]), int(point[1]))
        if start in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(start)
        pending = [start]
        component = []
        while pending:
            row, col = pending.pop()
            component.append((row, col))
            for direction in directions:
                nr = row + int(round(direction[0]))
                nc = col + int(round(direction[1]))
                neighbor = (nr, nc)
                if 0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width and neighbor not in visited and grid[nr, nc] == object_color:
                    visited.add(neighbor)
                    pending.append(neighbor)
        rows = [p[0] for p in component]
        cols = [p[1] for p in component]
        top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
        left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
        side = bottom - top + remainder
        span = right - left + remainder
        if side == span and len(component) == side * span and side % divisor == remainder:
            out[(top + bottom) // divisor, (left + right) // divisor] = marker_color
    return out

def run(params, grid, demos):
    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))
    fg = int(round(params['colors'][1]))
    closed_color = int(round(params['colors'][2]))
    open_color = int(round(params['colors'][3]))
    zero = int(round(params['constants'][0]))
    one = int(round(params['constants'][1]))
    directions = [(int(round(v[0])), int(round(v[1]))) for v in params['neighbors']]
    height, width = grid.shape
    out = np.full(grid.shape, bg, dtype=int)
    seen = set()
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            if grid[r, c] != fg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            pos = zero
            while pos < len(cells):
                y, x = cells[pos]
                pos += one
                for dy, dx in directions:
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if zero <= ny < height and zero <= nx < width and grid[ny, nx] == fg and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        cells.append((ny, nx))
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            bottom = max(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            right = max(x for y, x in cells)
            occupied = set(cells)
            empty = set()
            exterior = set()
            queue = []
            for y in range(top, bottom + one):
                for x in range(left, right + one):
                    if (y, x) not in occupied:
                        empty.add((y, x))
                        if y == top or y == bottom or x == left or x == right:
                            exterior.add((y, x))
                            queue.append((y, x))
            pos = zero
            while pos < len(queue):
                y, x = queue[pos]
                pos += one
                for dy, dx in directions:
                    point = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if point in empty and point not in exterior:
                        exterior.add(point)
                        queue.append(point)
            closed = len(empty) == zero or len(exterior) < len(empty)
            color = closed_color if closed else open_color
            shift = -left if closed else width - one - right
            for y, x in cells:
                nx = x + shift
                if zero <= nx < width:
                    out[y, nx] = color
    return out

    unit = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))

    direction = int(round(params['geometry'][2]))
    out = grid.copy()

        return out
    if not np.any(grid == bg):
        return out
    moves = []
    for pair in params['neighbors']:
        moves.append((int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))))
    h, w = grid.shape
    for color in np.unique(grid):
        if color == bg:
            continue
        remaining = set()
        for p in np.argwhere(grid == color):
            remaining.add((int(p[0]), int(p[1])))
        components = []
        while remaining:
            seed = remaining.pop()
            component = [seed]
            pending = [seed]
            while pending:
                r, c = pending.pop()
                for dr, dc in moves:
                    neighbor = (r + dr, c + dc)
                    if neighbor in remaining:
                        remaining.remove(neighbor)
                        pending.append(neighbor)
                        component.append(neighbor)
            components.append(component)
        if len(components) <= unit:
            continue
        target = max(components, key=lambda component: max(p[axis] for p in component))
        top = min(p[0] for p in target)
        bottom = max(p[0] for p in target)
        right = max(p[axis] for p in target)
        height = bottom - top + unit
        total = sum(len(component) for component in components)
        if total % height != 0:
            continue
        width = total // height
        left = right - direction * (width - unit)
        if left < 0 or right >= w:
            continue
        out[grid == color] = bg
        out[top:bottom + unit, left:right + unit] = color
    return out
